verdict.rationale: MX is an API-first platform with a documented REST/OpenAPI spec (mx-gh-1, mx-docs-12/26) and webhooks (mx-docs-7/22) that could be driven headlessly from CI, but there is no explicit evidence of a CLI, headless SDK mode, or documented CI/automation workflow — the Connect Widget appears UI-embedded (mx-docs-9, mx-docs-21) which cuts against pure headless use. missing for 10: explicit CI/headless usage docs, a CLI or automation-focused SDK, confirmation that Connect flows can run without embedded UI.
